subject: iran-war
story_title: Trump says no U.S. troops have been killed in five months. The Pentagon has announced deaths.

records.title: DOW Identifies Army Casualties
records.quote: was killed in action on July 18, 2026
records.about: Pentagon casualty release naming two soldiers killed in action in the July 17 enemy attack on Muwaffaq Salti Air Base, Jordan.

records.title: DOW Identifies an Army Casualty
records.quote: was killed in action during a controlled detonation of a downed One-Way Unmanned Aerial System on July 19, 2026, at Erbil Air Base, Iraq
records.about: Pentagon casualty release naming Sgt. Michael Swinton, killed in action July 19 at Erbil Air Base, Iraq.

records.title: DOW Identifies Army Casualty
records.quote: died on July 17, 2026, during an enemy attack at Muwaffaq Salti Air Base, Jordan
records.about: Pentagon release confirming Staff Sgt. Angel Rampersad, first listed as missing, was killed in the July 17 attack in Jordan.

records.title: Navy Identifies Helicopter Squadron Commander As Missing Sailor in Arabian Sea
records.quote: died July 1 after his helicopter ditched into the Arabian Sea
records.about: USNI News report of the Navy's identification of Cmdr. Gabriel Edwards, lost when his helicopter ditched July 1.

records.title: US military identifies two soldiers killed in Iranian attack on Jordan
records.quote: the first U.S. troop deaths from direct Iranian fire since the opening days of the war
records.about: AP report identifying the first two soldiers killed in the July 17 Iranian attack in Jordan.

records.title: US military identifies third service member believed to have been killed in Iranian attack
records.quote: The confirmation brings the death toll to 18 U.S. service members killed since the war began.
records.about: AP report that the third Jordan death brought the war's toll to 18, and that CENTCOM said the soldiers were deployed for the mission against the Islamic State.

records.title: Read the full transcript of Ross Douthat's interview with President Trump
records.quote: in the last six months, five months, six months we haven't lost one soldier
records.about: CBS's full transcript of Ross Douthat's interview with Trump, in which he says no soldier has been lost in five or six months and gives 18 killed.

records.title: Trump falsely claims ‘nobody’s been killed’ in Iran war ‘in the last five months’
records.quote: falsely claimed that no American troops had been killed in the past five months
records.about: The Washington Post's report on Trump's claim (the capture holds the summary and dek; the body was not served).

records.title: Two U.S. service members die amid Iran war, Pentagon tally shows
records.quote: In all, there have been 11 deaths from enemy fire and 12 nonhostile deaths, according to DCAS.
records.about: Washington Post report of two airmen's non-hostile deaths added to the Pentagon database, bringing the disclosed total to 23.

records.title: Virginia soldier becomes 19th known death since start of Iran war
records.quote: died Sept. 18 “as a result of a non-combat related incident.”
records.about: The Hill on Maj. Bianca Wilkerson's September 18 non-combat death, added to the Pentagon database.

records.title: Pentagon reveals more troops died during Iran war, raises toll to 21
records.quote: In September, an unidentified member of the Navy died by suicide, according to a Pentagon official who spoke on the condition of anonymity.
records.about: USA Today on the Pentagon raising the toll to 21 on October 9, adding a March death and a September Navy suicide.

records.title: President Trump Returns To The Hugh Hewitt Show
records.quote: Nobody’s been killed in the last five months.
records.about: The show's own transcript of Trump's November 12 interview with Hugh Hewitt, carried on the Salem News Channel, in which he says nobody has been killed in five months.

records.title: Operation Epic Fury, Lead Inspector General Report to the United States Congress, April 1, 2026–June 30, 2026
records.publisher: Lead Inspector General for Operation Epic Fury (Department of War Inspector General)
records.quote: U.S. Forces Deaths during OEF
records.about: The department inspector general's quarterly report to Congress on Operation Epic Fury, with a table of U.S. deaths that includes the July killed in action.

records.title: U.S. Conflict with Iran
records.quote: including an Iranian strike that killed three U.S. troops in Jordan on July 17
records.about: Congressional Research Service report on the U.S. conflict with Iran, updated September 18, 2026.

records.title: Pentagon ties new casualty category for renewed US-Iran fighting to the end of ‘Operation Epic Fury’
records.quote: because Operation Epic Fury has concluded, the military has decided to classify casualties tied to the latest strikes in the new category
records.about: AP report of the Pentagon's explanation for moving the July deaths into a new Overseas Operations category.

records.title: Pentagon Changes How It Reports Casualties in Iran War
records.quote: since Operation Epic Fury has concluded, the department classifies casualties as overseas operations in the CENTCOM area of responsibility
records.about: New York Times report on the Pentagon's new Overseas Operations casualty category and the administration's position that the July fighting is a new conflict.

records.title: Pentagon moves recent KIA numbers from Iran war into ‘Overseas Operations’ category
records.quote: On July 17 three U.S. service members were killed when an Iranian missile hit their sleeping barracks at Muwaffaq Salti Air Base in Jordan.
records.about: Military Times report on the move of the July killed in action into the Overseas Operations category.

records.title: Trump Wrongly Claims ‘Nobody’s Been Killed’ In Iran War In ‘Last Five Months’
records.quote: So far, 23 American service members have been killed in the conflict, including four in July, according to Military.com.
records.about: Mediaite's report of the Hewitt remark.

records.title: "Nobody hurt or killed in 5 months": Trump says US is not at war with Iran
records.quote: It can’t be a war when for five months nobody was hurt, killed, or anything else.
records.about: The Tribune (India), carrying ANI, quoting an earlier Trump remark that nobody was hurt or killed in five months.

records.title: Nation's Leaders Honor the Fallen During Dignified Transfer
records.quote: The deaths are related to Iranian aggression.
records.about: Pentagon News story on the July 22 dignified transfer at Dover attended by Trump, Hegseth and Gen. Caine.

records.title: CENTCOM Statement on Recently Fallen, Missing U.S. Service Members
records.quote: defended against Iranian ballistic missile and drone attacks
records.about: Central Command statement on the soldiers killed and missing in the July 17 attack in Jordan.

records.title: CENTCOM Update on Recently Fallen U.S. Service Members
records.quote: from a downed Iranian one-way attack drone
records.about: Central Command update on the Jordan attack and the soldier killed in northern Iraq.

records.quote:
to honor our
heroes

records.title: Trump pays respects to 4 US service members killed in the Middle East
records.quote: The president saluted as four transfer cases carrying the service members’ remains were escorted off an airplane during the dignified transfer at Dover Air Force Base.
records.about: AP report on Trump at the Dover dignified transfer.

records.title: The Intercept Sues to Reveal True Casualty Figures from War in Iran
records.quote: The case is The Intercept v. DOD

records.title: Duckworth, Bennet, Sanders, Van Hollen Release Joint Statement Opposing Spending Package that Funds Trump’s War on Iran
records.quote: December 11 funding deadline
records.about: Joint statement of four Senate Democrats opposing a spending deal that funds the war.

records.title: Trump Acknowledges Iran War Is Partly to Blame for Republican Losses
records.quote: “Iran was a piece of it,” he said
records.about: WSJ interview in which Trump said the Iran war was partly to blame for Republican midterm losses.

records.title: Military personnel told last month to stop calling Iran conflict "Operation Epic Fury"
records.quote: the Pentagon said Wednesday that Operation Epic Fury officially ended May 5
records.about: CBS News report that the Pentagon set May 5 as Operation Epic Fury's end date and in August told personnel to call the fighting overseas operations.
